eindtekst: Write SQL, run it, page through big results, save it for later, and materialize any result as a table.

stappen.tekst: Query is the SQL workbench over the workspace DuckDB. The sidebar lists every table with its row count, so superstore with its 51,290 rows is one click of context away.
Type the question you want answered. This aggregation sums sales per region and sorts the winners first.
stappen.text: SELECT region, SUM(sales) AS sales FROM superstore GROUP BY region ORDER BY sales DESC;

stappen.tekst: Run executes against the real table. Ctrl+Enter does the same from the keyboard. Only SELECT, CTAS, SHOW and DESCRIBE are allowed, so the workspace stays safe.
The grid shows real rows, not a spinner: one row per region, sales already sorted descending. The badge counts the total rows the query produced.
A query worth keeping is worth naming. Save stores it in the workspace so you can recall it any session.
Give the query a name. Description and tags are optional and make it findable later.
The SQL preview shows exactly what gets stored. Save query writes it to the workspace.
The Saved panel lists stored queries with SQL preview and tags. One click loads any of them back into the editor.
Back to the editor for the last stop of this tour.
Back at the editor with the region rollup. Any result can become a table: Ingest wraps the current query in a CREATE TABLE AS.
Name the table, optionally tag and group it, and Ingest lands it in Data. That is the full loop: question, result, table.
In a new tab, a full scan of superstore returns 51,290 rows across 6 pages. Big results page instead of choking the grid, with prev and next to walk them.
